plugins.subtitle: Sliding 808s, Heavy Basses & Modern Synth Keys
plugins.name: PLUGGED 1
plugins.description: An instrument plugin packed with ready-to-use 808s that slide smoothly, punchy sub-basses, and atmospheric synth keys that never clutter your mix.
features: Self-Cutting 808 Engine: Bass notes automatically cut each other off so your low end never turns muddy
Zero-Click Note Transitions: Smooth note starts and stops without annoying speaker thuds
Studio-Ready Presets: From warm vintage electric pianos to modern sliding drill basses
Stereo Unison Spreader: Make synth leads sound wide and massive across headphones

plugins.subtitle: Real-Time Vocal Pitch Correction & Hard AutoTune
plugins.name: PLUGTNE
plugins.description: Get that crisp, instant radio vocal sound. Snaps your vocals into perfect pitch in real time with zero delay so you can sing and record live without lag.
features: Zero Delay Live Recording: Sing into your mic and hear tuned vocals instantly in your headphones
From Natural to Hard-Tune: Dial from gentle natural pitch correction to robotic Travis Scott snapping
Key & Scale Selector: Simply pick your song key (Major, Minor, Chromatic) and start recording
Live Pitch Visualizer: Watch your vocal hit the target notes on a clean real-time display
Universal DAW Compatibility: Ultra-stable VST3 and AU operation with zero crashes

plugins.subtitle: Analog Tube Heat & Heavy 808 Sub Saturation
plugins.name: UNDERGRND
plugins.description: Makes your 808s rattle through iPhone speakers and gives vocals that warm, gritty analog heat heard on modern dark trap records.
features: 12AX7 Analog Tube Drive: Adds warm harmonic distortion so bass cuts through small phone speakers
Sub-Bass Generator: Adds deep, tuned rumble underneath thin kicks and basslines
Vocal Demon Formant Pitch: Shift vocal tone down for deep monster tones or up for pitched hooks
Mix Blend Knob: Dial in aggressive distortion without losing your original clean vocal or beat
Tone Sculpting Filters: Clean up low-end rumble or tame top-end fizz with one twist

plugins.subtitle: One-Slider Vocal Leveler & Background Noise Gate
plugins.name: PLUGVOX
plugins.description: The easiest way to make vocals sound professional. One slider brings quiet whispers and loud singing to the exact same upfront, in-your-face volume.
features: Effortless 2-Slider Workflow: One slider for vocal volume leveling, one slider to silence room noise
Upfront Vocal Presence: Locks the artist voice directly at the front of the speakers
Instant Protection: Prevents sudden loud vocal screams from distorting
Live LED Meters: See your volume reduction clearly in real time

plugins.subtitle: Smooth Vintage Vocal Compressor (Warm & Buttery)
plugins.name: PLUGOPTO
plugins.description: Modeled after the famous ,000 vintage optical compressor used on thousands of platinum records. Makes singing sound warm, smooth, and natural without harshness.
features: Musical, Butter-Smooth Compression: Never sounds choked or squashed, even when pushed hard
Classic 2-Knob Simplicity: Turn the Peak Reduction knob until the vocal sits right in the pocket
Authentic Tube Warmth: Gently fattens thin microphone recordings with vintage analog vibe
Photorealistic Analog VU Meter: Classic needle movement responding naturally to your music

plugins.subtitle: Drum & Master Bus Glue Compressor
plugins.name: PLUGGLUE
plugins.description: The secret to making your tracks sound like a finished record. Glues all your drums and instruments together into one tight, punchy, cohesive sound.
features: The British Console Glue: Binds kicks, snares, and instruments together into a single wall of sound
Bass-Safe Filter: Keeps your heavy kick drum from accidentally squashing the rest of the song
Parallel Mix Knob: Blend punchy aggressive compression with your original clean drums
Stepped Precision Knobs: Instant classic ratios (2:1, 4:1, 10:1) for fast decision making

plugins.subtitle: Clean Visual Equalizer & Sound Sculptor
plugins.name: PLUG EQ
plugins.description: See your audio frequencies on screen and carve out unwanted muddiness or boost crisp highs by simply dragging dots on the graph.
features: Interactive Visual Graph: See the exact frequency peaks of your sounds as you play them
Drag-and-Drop Nodes: Double-click anywhere to boost crisp highs, add warm bass, or cut harsh frequencies
Dynamic Frequency Taming: Smoothly lowers annoying harsh peaks only when they get too loud
Mastering-Grade Transparency: Zero phase distortion for pristine, clean audio

plugins.subtitle: Streaming Loudness Maximizer & Peak Limiter
plugins.name: PLUGLIMIT
plugins.description: The final step before releasing your song. Pull the fader down to make your track loud, competitive, and punchy for Spotify and Apple Music without distorting.
features: Effortless Loudness: Push your overall song volume up to commercial streaming standards in seconds
True-Peak Brickwall Clamp: Stops audio from going over 0 dB and causing digital clipping
Linked Threshold & Ceiling: Turn up the loudness with a single smooth fader motion
Live Waveform Display: Watch peaks flatten into smooth commercial volume

plugins.subtitle: Smart Studio Vocal Echo & Stereo Delay
plugins.name: PLUGDELAY
plugins.description: Adds rich, rhythmic echoes to vocals and instruments that automatically get out of the way when the artist is singing so words never get buried.
features: Smart Auto-Ducking: Echoes stay quiet while the artist sings, then bloom into the pauses
BPM Tempo Sync: Echoes bounce perfectly in time with your DAW project tempo
Stereo Ping-Pong Spreader: Bounces echoes between left and right ears for wide 3D space
Analog Tape Warmth: Smooth vintage high-cut filters so repeats sound warm instead of harsh

plugins.subtitle: Lush Studio Acoustic Reverb & Space Maker
plugins.name: PLUGVERB
plugins.description: Puts your dry vocals and instruments into a luxurious studio room, concert hall, or cozy vocal booth so your music sounds 3D, wide, and alive.
features: Silky-Smooth Reverb Tail: Zero cheap metallic ringing or hollow frequencies
Multiple Room Sizes: Pick between intimate vocal booths, studio rooms, and giant ambient spaces
Pre-Delay Vocal Timing: Keeps your lead vocal upfront and crisp before the reverb wash kicks in
Modulation Chorusing: Adds subtle movement so long reverb trails sound warm and lush

plugins.subtitle: All-in-One Multi-Plugin Vocal & Channel Strip
plugins.name: PLUGRACK
plugins.description: Stack your autotune, vocal compressor, EQ, and reverb inside one clean window so you don't have 10 different windows cluttering your screen.
features: Single-Window Simplicity: Run your entire vocal chain in one organized master rack
1-Click Custom Chains: Save your favorite complete vocal or drum setups instantly
Drag-and-Drop Reordering: Easily swap plugin order (e.g. EQ before Compressor vs. after)
Master Gain Staging: Calibrated input and output faders with mono compatibility checker

plugins.subtitle: Instant Half-Time, Beat Slicer & Rhythm Shaper
plugins.name: PLUGCHOP
plugins.description: The ultimate beat-flipping tool. Turn boring melodies into bouncy trap patterns, half-time slow-downs, vinyl scratches, and stutter chops with easy draggable visual curves.
features: 16 Quick-Flip Presets: Instant 1/2 Time, Tape Stops, Reverse, 1/8 Chops, and Stutters
Visual Curve Drawing: Click and bend lines directly on screen to shape custom rhythms
Automatic BPM Lock: Stays perfectly in time with your DAW tempo automatically
Smooth Anti-Click Engine: Seamless glitch transitions with zero audio pops or clicks
Analog Tape Warmth & Mood Filter: Built-in warmth saturation and vintage low-pass filter

plugins.name: PLUGSILKY
plugins.subtitle: High-End Air, Sheen & Final Vocal Polish
plugins.description: Adds that expensive, silky top-end sheen to vocals and acoustic instruments without making them harsh or painful to the ear.
features: Expensive Studio Air: Gives vocals and cymbals that crisp, airy brightness heard on top pop records
Harsh-Free Smoothing: Brightens audio without creating painful S and T sibilance
Safe Stereo Widener: Gently spreads high frequencies wide while keeping bass 100% in the center
Zero-Latency Polishing: Fast enough to keep active during vocal tracking

plugins.name: PLUGBLUE
plugins.subtitle: Aggressive Fast Drum & Vocal Punch Compressor
plugins.description: The fastest compressor in the suite. Grabs sharp snare drums and aggressive rap vocals instantly, giving them explosive punch and energy.
features: Ultra-Fast Transient Clamp: Grabs snappy drum transients in microseconds to make snares smack
All-Buttons Slam Mode: Extreme aggressive compression for explosive drum rooms and rock vocals
Biting Analog Grit: Adds energy and forward attitude to modern rap and trap vocal deliveries
Vintage British Character: Faithfully recreates the iconic Blue-Stripe analog circuit

plugins.name: PLUGWARP
plugins.subtitle: Instant Tape Stops, Slow-Downs & Sample Pitch Warper
plugins.description: Slow down, speed up, or twist any melody upside down in real time — create instant vinyl slowdowns, lo-fi vocal chops, and trippy beat transitions with zero effort.
features: Vinyl Turntable Tape Stop: One-click slowdown effect that sounds like a real turntable braking
Instant Half-Time & Double-Time: Flip chord progressions and melodies into moody slow-mo vibes
Formant Vocal Pitch Bender: Transpose vocals up or down without making them chipmunk or robotic
Ethereal Space Blur: Smears raw sounds into dreamy, atmospheric background pads for your beats

manager.release_notes: PluggedIN Central v3.0.5: Official high-resolution macOS (.icns) and Windows (.ico) branding icons, and performance improvements.
